verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a first-party Sandbox SDK, usable from Workers, that runs untrusted code in isolated containers, each with its own full Linux environment. The evidence never says the isolation is hardware-level (VM or microVM rather than container), and it never shows sandboxes being created and destroyed per task; the example uses a stable per-user sandbox ID, so disposability is unproven. missing for 10: evidence of hardware/VM-level isolation, documented disposable/ephemeral sandbox lifecycle, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run untrusted code in hardware-isolated, disposable sandboxes

citations.quote: The Sandbox SDK enables you to run untrusted code securely in isolated environments.
Each sandbox runs in its own isolated container with a full Linux environment
